decision.observation: Hornet is high against the dark mossy left wall of the giant chamber; the lit chamber with the pale creature lies below-right. The chamber appears closed except for the pale creature itself.
decision.hypothesis: The pale creature may be a large shell-shard 'totem': each strike bursts it and yields shards, like earlier shell creatures. Depleting it might open an exit or grant significant reward, and a bench is close by for healing.
decision.memory: Pale creature bursts on contact/strike, costing ~1 mask per hit. Worth testing full depletion with repeated X strikes.
